_note: A45: the house vision stack, pinned. Model files live outside git (DOCUMENT_VISION_MODELS, default model_dir); each is checked against its sha256 before use, and a mismatch is a missing model (the pipeline degrades, never blocks). The VL is pinned by its Ollama digest. Bump a pin only with a new sha256 and a rulebook note: every cached measurement is keyed by these.

vl._note: Place, object and text regions only, never a person (founder ruling (b), A48); cold: the model is unloaded before every still, so no prompt cache survives (proof 2026-10-17: 10/10 byte-identical twice cold, 5/10 raw and 8/10 normalized warm; prompt v2: 32 stills, then 10 again from cold, the same sidecar bytes). min_pixels: each picture is sent at the smallest size of its shape at or over 1024 patches of 28 x 28, the model's own floor, so its boxes are in the picture's pixels (A48).
